title: Sectioning Rat Heart
author: Shaina Robbins
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w53fg8n

steps.title: Equilibrate Heart Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the rat heart from the -80 °C freezer to the cryostat and let it sit for at least 20-30 minutes to allow the OCT to equalize to the cryostat temperature and prevent cracking.

steps.title: Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Set the cryostat to the desired tissue thickness and begin the sectioning process.

steps.title: Collect Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Gently collect the tissue sections onto slides, typically collecting two sections per slide.

substeps.instruction: Select slide type (e.g., superfrost glass +, histobond, frame membrane, or glass membrane).

steps.title: Store Slides
steps.instruction: Immediately place the slides into a box containing dry ice until they can be transferred to the -80 °C freezer.
